features.userStory: As a first-time visitor, I can land on the homepage and immediately understand who Breno is and where to go next.
features.expectedBehavior: The home layout renders logo, site title, short bio, social buttons, and primary CTA buttons to About, Writing, Talks & Media, Projects, and Contact.
features.notes: Home hero, CTA buttons, and social presentation matched the layout.

features.userStory: As a visitor on any page, I can open the menu and reach the main sections, profile info, and public social links.
features.expectedBehavior: The hamburger menu opens a nested About submenu with profile details and enabled social links, plus links for Home, Writing, Projects, Talks & Media, Contact, and Tags.
features.notes: Menu links rendered correctly from nav plus navigation data.

features.userStory: As a visitor, I can read a concise biography and jump from the About page into the site's key sections.
features.expectedBehavior: The About page renders biography copy and CTA buttons for Projects, Writing, Talks & Media, Tags, and Contact.
features.notes: About page biography and CTA buttons rendered as expected.

features.userStory: As a reader, I can browse the writing archive and open article posts from a dedicated listing page.
features.expectedBehavior: The Writing archive lists only posts whose effective content type is article, with title, excerpt, and Read More button for each item.
features.notes: Writing archive rendered 11 article entries with excerpts and buttons.

features.userStory: As a visitor, I can browse talks, podcasts, interviews, and press mentions from one archive.
features.expectedBehavior: The Talks & Media archive lists only posts with content_type media, with title, excerpt, and Read More button for each item.
features.notes: Media archive rendered 39 media entries.

features.userStory: As a visitor, I can browse Breno's projects from a dedicated archive page.
features.expectedBehavior: The Projects archive lists only posts with content_type project, with title, excerpt, and Read More button for each item.
features.notes: Projects archive rendered 23 project entries.

features.userStory: As a visitor using an old link, I am redirected to the current archive instead of hitting a dead end.
features.expectedBehavior: Legacy archive aliases render noindex canonical pages that immediately refresh to their current destinations: /posts/ -> /articles/ and /interviews/ -> /media/.
features.notes: Legacy aliases redirected to canonical archive URLs in browser.

features.userStory: As a reader, I can browse content by tag and jump directly to the posts under each tag.
features.expectedBehavior: The Tag Archive lists all tags with counts, creates anchor sections for each tag, and tag links in post metadata point to the matching section anchor.
features.notes: Tags archive rendered 88 tag anchors and post lists.

features.userStory: As a reader, I can open an article, project, or media post and get consistent framing around the content.
features.expectedBehavior: The post layout renders title, date, reading time, archive-aware back button, markdown body, tags, and a tweet-share link; comments appear only when enabled.
features.notes: Post template showed title, date, reading time, back button, tags, and tweet link.

features.userStory: As a visitor on a media page, I can view embedded players without the layout breaking on desktop or mobile.
features.expectedBehavior: Embedded iframes and videos render inside the content column, resize responsively, and the first media node gains a stable media-player anchor target.
features.notes: Responsive YouTube media page rendered and received media-player anchor.

features.userStory: As a media consumer, I can skim a chapter list and jump the player to the relevant timestamp.
features.expectedBehavior: Generated media chapter blocks render topical timestamps; clicking a timestamp seeks an embedded YouTube player or HTML5 video when supported and scrolls the player into view, otherwise the fallback anchor still points to the player block.
features.issueSummary: Quant Finance initially embedded a YouTube watch URL inside an iframe, which prevented chapter clicks from seeking the player. The page now uses an embed URL.
features.notes: Retest confirmed chapter click rewrites the iframe src with start and autoplay params on /quant-finance-investimento/.

features.userStory: As a visitor on a transcript-backed media page, I can read a structured transcript without leaving the post.
features.expectedBehavior: When transcript appendix data exists, the post renders collapsible transcript sections with source, timestamps, and optional speaker labels; if the transcript starts far below the fold, a transcript jump note appears near the player.
features.notes: Transcript section and transcript jump note both rendered on tested media page.

features.userStory: As a visitor on a media page that uses a native video element, I can use chapter timestamps to seek the local player.
features.expectedBehavior: When the first media node is an HTML5 video, chapter clicks update currentTime, trigger playback if possible, and preserve the same anchor-based navigation affordance.
features.notes: HTML5 video chapter click updated video currentTime to the selected timestamp.

features.userStory: As a visitor on a project page, I can read richer content blocks like diagrams, media, linked documents, and outbound project resources.
features.expectedBehavior: Project posts can render buttons, images, embedded media, PDF links, and Mermaid diagrams when mermaid: true is present.
features.notes: Granola project rendered iframe, linked PDF/resources, image, and Mermaid SVG.

features.userStory: As a visitor who wants to reach out, I can fill out a contact form and land on a success page after submission.
features.expectedBehavior: The contact page renders required email, name, and message fields, a hidden honeypot field, a Formspree POST action, and a success redirect target to /contact-success/; the success page confirms delivery and links back to the form.
features.issueSummary: External form submission not exercised because it would send data to Formspree. Markup, required fields, and success target verified.
features.notes: Safe local verification completed; end-to-end submission requires explicit approval.

features.userStory: As a visitor who follows a bad link, I get a recovery page instead of a blank or confusing error.
features.expectedBehavior: The 404 page renders a plain apology message and a working recovery contact or navigation path.
features.issueSummary: The 404 page originally rendered mailto:?subject=Page%20not%20found because site.email is unset. It now routes users to Contact and Home instead.
features.notes: Retest confirmed both recovery links render correctly on /404.html.

features.userStory: As a visitor or crawler, I receive correct titles, descriptions, canonical URLs, and social metadata for each page type.
features.expectedBehavior: Head tags are populated from page or site data for title, description, keywords, canonical, robots, Twitter, Open Graph, and JSON-LD; feed, sitemap, and llms links are present.
features.notes: Canonical, description, and social metadata matched tested routes.

features.userStory: As a reader, I only see a comments area on the small subset of pages that explicitly enable comments.
features.expectedBehavior: The Disqus thread container and embed scripts load only when page.comments is true; pages with comments false do not render the thread block.
features.notes: Confirmed the comments-enabled route /ordinals-devem-ser-banidos/ renders the Disqus container and scripts.

features.userStory: As a reader, I can open linked image assets in an overlay gallery instead of leaving the page.
features.expectedBehavior: Anchor tags that directly target JPG, JPEG, PNG, or GIF assets receive the image-popup class and open in the Magnific Popup gallery.
features.issueSummary: No current published page in the built site uses linked image anchors, so the lightbox code path could not be exercised from live content.
features.notes: Static search over _site_goaltest found no a[href$=.jpg|.png|.gif] examples to test.

features.userStory: As a visitor, I get a small amount of navigation and scrolling polish without losing usability.
features.expectedBehavior: Archive items animate in with WOW.js, clicking zoombtn links triggers a fade transition class swap, and a Go Up button appears after scrolling past the trigger point.
features.notes: WOW classes were present on archive items and the Go Up container became visible after scrolling.

features.userStory: As a reader or crawler using feed and machine-readable endpoints, I can access the site's published discovery files.
features.expectedBehavior: The site publishes feed.xml, sitemap.xml, and llms.txt, and links to those outputs from the page head where configured.
features.notes: Direct checks returned HTTP 200 for /feed.xml, /sitemap.xml, and /llms.txt.
